$comment: The HL7 FHIR validator the gate runs (0005): the command-line JAR of one release of hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core, fetched from that release's assets and refused unless its SHA-256 is this one. The hash was read from GitHub's digest of the asset and from the downloaded file, which agreed, on 17 October 2026. `java` is the oldest Java the JAR runs on: its manifest says `Build-Jdk-Spec: 17` and its classes are version 61. Read by scripts/validator.mjs and scripts/compatibility.mjs; held by scripts/validator/registers.test.mjs. A new release is adopted by changing all of it in one commit, with a CHANGELOG line saying why.
